Simulate epidemiological DLNM scenarios

Source: R/simulate_scenarios.R
simulate_scenarios.Rd

Simulate epidemiological DLNM scenarios

Usage

simulate_scenarios(
  fit,
  dat,
  wx_long,
  lag_windows,
  scenarios,
  lag_max,
  df_var = 4,
  df_lag = 4,
  fun_var = "ns",
  fun_lag = "ns",
  ref_vals = NULL,
  pop_level = TRUE
)

Arguments

fit

Fitted model

dat

Original design matrix

wx_long

Long-format weather data

lag_windows

Lag windows

scenarios

Output from simulate_range()

lag_max

Maximum lag

df_var

Degrees of freedom (exposure)

df_lag

Degrees of freedom (lag)

fun_var

Basis function for exposure

fun_lag

Basis function for lag

ref_vals

Reference values

pop_level

Logical
